dossier.headline: Kaynes Technology slumps after a 61.6% profit fall
dossier.summary: Kaynes Technology's September-quarter net profit fell 61.6% year on year. The stock fell about 15% on Monday morning to a 52-week low of ₹2,915.50, among the sharpest falls on the NSE.
why_it_matters: It is one of the steepest results-day reactions of the September-quarter season
The fall came on a day when large caps were rallying
